  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment turns negative (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00) and historical mean reversion is observed.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above 30-day moving average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is negative and recent price action shows downward momentum.",
    "Avoid overreacting to early sentiment shifts — delay correction until 2-3 periods after sentiment change.",
    "If sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.50) and forecast is below historical mean, slightly increase forecast to align with sentiment.",
    "Correct for lagged reactions: if true outcome is significantly below forecast, adjust next period’s forecast downward by 5-10%."
